dataset: Weak-case explanation examples for the 152M explanation stage (TRAINING_PLAN B3)

settings._about: explorer/weak_cases.py (TRAINING_PLAN stage B3, set 29 Oct before any result): training and dev explanation examples of the round-1 writer's weak cases (a method other than the baseline, reworded instructions of its own, shuffled facts, three or four reasons), drawn as random_test.hard_record draws with its own seeds; no frozen test prompt, and dev never repeats a train prompt. manyReasonShare of rows draw z from manyReasonMixture (more contributing and flag-level values).
settings._dev: The writer's dev tier for stages B3-B6: dev.jsonl plus devVal prompts drawn with devValSeed from DS7 v2's val.jsonl (both are dev data; the test tier stays untouched). The gate pairs the two writers prompt by prompt (bootstrap over prompts, McNemar); a case's allowed fall is the binomial standard error of the earlier writer's rate on that case, as the writer has no seed spread at M0.
